name: Bel'Veth
notes: Void Surge's four independent cardinal-direction cooldowns are approximated as a single averaged cooldown (the reduced per-side cooldown divided by 4), since a static single-target fight has no real directionality; Q is cast on cooldown.
Above and Below's champion-hit Q-cooldown reset is approximated by immediately readying the averaged Q cooldown the instant W lands, since the dummy is champion-flagged and always hit.

Royal Maelstrom's bonus-slash count from attack speed uses the wiki's literal '+1 slash per 40% bonus attack speed' reading rather than the sheet's unresolved/mismatched AttackSpeedMult=8 value; the resulting slashes are spaced evenly across the 1.5s channel.

Royal Maelstrom is always run to its full duration rather than cancelled early: this blocks Q, W and normal attacks for that duration, matching the dossier's proposed rotation and the mechanic that casting another ability ends Maelstrom early.

Endless Banquet's active cast is never used: it requires an existing Void Coral, which only spawns from a takedown, and the dummy is never killed; only its always-on passive (stacking bonus true damage on each on-hit application, uncapped against a champion target) is modeled.

The passive's bonus true damage applies at full effectiveness on basic attacks and on Void Surge's hit to the first target, and at reduced effectiveness (12% x the target's missing-health fraction) during Royal Maelstrom's slashes, per the wiki's on-hit reduction during that ability.

Lavender's permanent attack-speed stacks require takedowns unobtainable in a static dummy fight; an assumed starting count of 10 stacks is used (see `assumed`). The dossier's per-level, per-stack progression (0.1 to 2.0) is already expressed directly in percent (its own quote spells this out as '0.1%; then +0.05*x...'), so it is used as-is without an extra x100 conversion.

Casting any ability refreshes 20% bonus attack speed for 3 seconds (Death in Lavender's ghosting buff); this is the kit's own attack-speed contribution, on top of whatever bonus attack speed the engine already grants from items.
Mana/cost is not modeled: none of Bel'Veth's abilities have a listed cost.

Item on-hit riders (attack_riders) are only triggered on genuine basic attacks; Void Surge's and Royal Maelstrom's hits deal Bel'Veth's own kit damage (including the Endless Banquet passive) but are not modeled as triggering generic item on-hit procs, since the engine's on-hit hook is attack-specific.

assumed.why: permanent Lavender attack-speed stacks come only from takedowns, unobtainable in a static dummy fight; assumes a plausible level-16 mid/late-game stack count
